name: rostrum
description: Clean up talk recordings: find redos, retakes and dead air, review every cut, render and verify.
long_description: rostrum finds redos, retakes, repeats and dead air in talk recordings, lets you review every proposed cut, then renders with ffmpeg and verifies the result. Everything runs locally. Needs ffmpeg/ffprobe 6.1 or newer on PATH; the first analysis downloads a speech model of about 480 MB.
